# The extended-range blend table without fast math (the blend table's configurations,
# metal2vulkan-devtools `xr_blends`). Metal's answers: plain Metal on an Apple M4 under macOS 27.0.1
# (26A434), the lane-table probe built with -fmetal-math-mode=safe (built with
# -fmetal-math-mode=relaxed, gave every band the same bytes), our own probe
# over synthetic inputs. Each configuration drew into its own 64 x 4 band of every case's target
# (the same 256 raw texels and outputs in every band) under its scissor and blend color, in one pass
# that loads and stores it.
#   cfg <index> <source rgb> <destination rgb> <rgb op> <source alpha> <destination alpha>
#       <alpha op> <write mask> <blend color: 4 f32 bits>      (Metal's enum numbers)
#   inputs <format> <h|f> <FNV-1a 64 of a band's plane 0> <of its alpha bytes> <of its outputs>
#   row <format> <h|f> <index> <FNV-1a 64 of the band's plane 0 after the pass> <of its alpha
#       bytes> <metal2vulkan's outcome: made, or the ExtendedRangeBlend gap refusing it>
